- 0:00–0:05: Quick intros + goals (Ava)
- 0:05–0:20: Demo + perf examples focused on your prompt patterns (Ben)
- 0:20–0:30: Deployment/guardrails + SLOs and rollout (Rachel)

Ill tentatively hold 10:45–11:20 PDT on Thursday and will send a calendar invite once you confirm.
